main_text.p: μὴν τύχης, ἢ ἐχεγεναμέων, δικαίως αὐτὸν πάντων ἐλεηθείλω, ego igitur ob fortunā, qua usus sum, merito apud omnes misericordiam consequar. Sic ϛηλῶ σε τῆς ἐλευθεριότητος admiror te atq; imitandum iudico ob liberalitatē. ἐΔημονίζω σε τῆς παῤῥησίας, beatum te judico propter libertatem loquendi. φιλεῖ αὐτὸν τῆς ἀρετῆς, amat illum ob virtutem. ἀξιῶ σε τιμῆς, dignor te honore. In primo genere subaudiunt ἐκ, in secundo ἐκ vel ὑπὸ, in postremo ἕνεκα.
main_text.head: Præpositio addita efficienti.
main_text.p: Aliquando præpositio additur. λίθοι ἐκ πυρὸς ἀφαροῦς, lapides ex igne transfluentes. Hesiod.
ἀλλ' μὲν μεσσάσαν τῷ δὲ γείτονος, ἀλλ' ἡ ἀπο-δώσαι, αὐτὰρ τῷ μέσῳ,--

p.i: Bene quidem mensurator á vicino, bene verò redde,

page.notes: Greek text is partly blurred and several words are uncertain; the Greek transcription above is approximate. The catchword and final line are only partly legible. The first Greek line and the line "ne verò redde" are likely dislocated; the text is reproduced as best read.
